name: columnDatum_mul_ite_eq
summary: When the columns of z off e are those of 1, the column datum of z is χ(det z) or 0 according as w·φ(z) = w; then a split on the invertibility of z, with the invariance of F under z⁻¹, gives both sides.

steps.claim: If FixesColsOff e z holds, then columnDatum χ φ w e (z_e) = χ(det z) when w·φ(z) = w, and 0 otherwise. Indeed z = 1 + (z − 1)·I_e·I_eᵀ (the columns off e are those of 1; checked by grind), so the rows e of the columns e of z form I_eᵀ·z·I_e, whose determinant is det(1 + I_eᵀ(z − 1)I_e) = det(1 + (z − 1)I_e I_eᵀ) = det z (det(1 + AB) = det(1 + BA)); and w·φ(z)·I_e = w·I_e is equivalent to w·φ(z) = w, because right multiplication by I_eᵀ is injective (I_eᵀ·I_e = 1).
steps.lean:
have K (c : FixesColsOff e z) : columnDatum χ φ w e (z.submatrix id e) = ite (w * z.map φ =
    w) (χ z.det) 0 := (by grind [Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_sub, sub_mul] : z = 1 + (z - 1) * inclMatrix
    R e * (inclMatrix R e)ᵀ) ▸ by simp [columnDatum, ← mul_inclMatrix, ← inclMatrix_transpose_mul,
    Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ᵀ, map_inclMatrix,
    det_one_add_mul_comm _ᵀ, Matrix.map_add, transpose_map, ← w.mul_assoc,
    (mul_left_injective_of_inv _ _ (inclMatrix_transpose_mul_self e)).eq_iff' (Matrix.zero_mul _)]
steps.typed_fact:
columnDatum χ φ w e (z.submatrix id e) = ite (w * z.map φ =
    w) (χ z.det) 0

steps.claim: Split on whether z is invertible. If z is the matrix of a unit Z, then Z ∈ H exactly when FixesColsOff e z and w·φ(z) = w; in that case both sides equal χ(det z)·F(y), since F(z⁻¹y) = F(y) by hF applied to Z⁻¹ ∈ H; otherwise both sides are 0 by step 1. If z is not invertible, det z is not a unit, so χ(det z) = 0 (a multiplicative character vanishes on non-units) and no element of H has matrix z: both sides are 0.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ | _ := em (IsUnit z) <;> simp_all [χ.map_nonunit, isUnit_iff_isUnit_det,
    Units.val_inj, rowStabilizer] <;> grind [mul_inv_cancel_left_of_invertible]
